name: Geode Miss-Click Manager
description: Ignores accidental extra clicks and shows a classic Geometry Dash style counter when it does.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the click filter on or off.

min-click-gap.name: Click Gap (ms)
min-click-gap.description: Ignore a click that comes this soon after your previous click. 0 turns this off.

respawn-grace.name: Respawn Grace (ms)
respawn-grace.description: Ignore clicks for this long after you respawn. 0 turns this off.

show-counter.name: Show Counter
show-counter.description: Show an Ignored Clicks counter when a click is ignored.

fade-time.name: Fade Delay (seconds)
fade-time.description: How long the counter stays on screen before it fades away.

always-show.name: Always Show
always-show.description: Keep the counter on screen instead of letting it fade away.

reset-on-restart.name: Reset On Restart
reset-on-restart.description: Clear the counter and hide it every time the attempt restarts.

position.name: Position
position.description: Which corner of the screen the counter appears in.

opacity.name: Opacity (%)
opacity.description: How see-through the counter is. 100 is fully solid.
